get.description: Retrieves the employee directory from TalentHR.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of employees to return. TalentHR defaults to 10 when this is omitted.

schema.description: Maximum number of employees to return. TalentHR defaults to 10 when this is omitted.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset. Use -1 to disable pagination for this endpoint.

schema.description: Pagination offset. Use -1 to disable pagination for this endpoint.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional directory filter ID. Use the Directory Filters endpoint to discover valid filter IDs before using this field.

schema.description: Optional directory filter ID. Use the Directory Filters endpoint to discover valid filter IDs before using this field.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An RSQL expression used to filter the results.

isOwner.description: Whether the employee is the workspace owner.

timeOffRequests.description: Time off requests linked to the employee.
